Designed for quick checks of horizontal, vertical, and 45-degree angles, it features a flat base, tinted 360-degree vials for readability from above, and built-in hang holes. Includes a blue-gray plastic body with yellow-green vial accents and dual bubble vial housings along its length.

images.alt_text: Stanley 8-inch spirit torpedo level in grey.

key_features: Top-reading feature allows visibility from above

raw_products.title: Magnetic Torpedo Level
raw_products.description: The Johnson Level 9-inch magnetic torpedo level is designed for quickly and easily finding plumb, level, and 45-degree angles. It features a reinforced aluminum frame with high-impact panels for enhanced durability and a top-read window for convenient viewing. For versatility, it includes a rubber magnetic edge for hands-free use on ferrous metal surfaces and a V-groove frame that fits securely on pipes and conduits, making it an ideal tool for plumbing and electrical work.

images.alt_text: Magnetic torpedo level with yellow and green indicator segments on a plain white background.

key_features: V-groove frame fits on pipe and conduit

raw_products.title: 8" Torpedo Level
raw_products.description: The Stanley 8" Torpedo Level (42-294) is a durable and accurate measuring tool designed for high visibility on the jobsite. Constructed from impact-resistant ABS plastic in a bright orange color, it features tinted 360° vials for easy readability and a top-read feature for convenient visibility from above for marking. It also includes a pipe groove for specialized leveling tasks.

raw_products.title: Magnetic Torpedo Level
raw_products.description: This is a durable 9-inch torpedo level manufactured by Empire, featuring a solid aluminum frame for long-lasting use. It is magnetic, allowing for hands-free work on metal surfaces like pipes. The level includes durable acrylic vials that provide accurate readings for plumb (vertical), level (horizontal), and 45-degree angles. It also features a top-read window for overhead viewing and a convenient hang hole for easy storage.

images.alt_text: Aluminum magnetic torpedo level in blue and silver with yellow magnetic attachments.

key_features: Durable acrylic vials for plumb, level, and 45-degree readings
Tapered edge for easy access in pockets and pouches

raw_products.title: 9 in. Plastic Torpedo Level 3 vial
raw_products.description: This Ace 9-inch torpedo level features a durable plastic construction and three vials for accurate measurements of plumb, level, and 45-degree angles. Its high-impact, non-conductive, and non-corrosive frame makes it ideal for electrical work, and the V-groove design ensures a secure fit on pipes and conduit.

raw_products.title: Plastic 6-in 3 Vial Torpedo level
raw_products.description: A Project Source 6-inch torpedo level made from high-impact ABS plastic. This tool features three bubble level vials for checking leveling as well as 45, 90, and 180-degree angles, providing clear and accurate readings. It is designed for use in home or workshop environments and meets ANSI standards.
